author: Widogeist
body:
There's a [translator application](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfGLwHv0AQZvchb1LaaK_OShpczZqgY8_vcdyCUc9xaFnzvA/viewform) that was posted back in April 2025 on Discord you could try. Alternatively, I would recommend going on the main Orna (or HoA - whichever game you play) Discord and let them know you were wanting to help translate; a moderator should reach out and let you know if they're currently looking for translators for that specific language.

[Orna Discord](https://discord.gg/orna) and [HoA Discord](https://discord.gg/K3yXQhbmAV)
